document.title: Class Paragon Paths
document.introduction: At level 11, you choose a paragon path. These class paths grant features at 11th and 16th level and an encounter attack, a utility power and a daily power at 11th, 12th and 20th level.
document.source: Published D&D 4e paragon paths, adapted to Modern 4e wording; combat effects remain manual.

paths.title: Academy Master
paths.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.

limitations: Authoring and printed rules only; runtime path effects and progression are unimplemented.
Published prerequisite not enforced: Any arcane class.

paths.flavor: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.

paths.title: Arcane Armorer
paths.description: Turn your allies' armor into a spellcaster's weapon, laying wards that blunt incoming energy and make shielded friends harder to exploit. Spending an action point lets you hand a nearby ally resistance to a chosen energy type, while your healing infusions keep that ally from granting combat advantage. Wisdom adds to every resistance you grant, and your powers siphon defenses off an enemy, teleport a battered ally to your side, or fill an armored ally with force that hurls foes away.

paths.title: Battle Engineer
paths.description: Leave the workshop behind and take your artifice straight into the front line. Your action point turns you into a harder-hitting combatant, and the weapon enchantments you grant allies become brutal and, later, noticeably more accurate. You can empower every ally standing beside you with a single strike, lace a weapon with lasting elemental force that sets critical targets burning, and fasten a zone of stinging motes to an enemy that punishes it for standing still.

paths.title: Clockwork Engineer
paths.description: Fill the battlefield with devices of your own making and treat them like members of the party. Spending an action point grants extra minor actions to command your summoned creatures, which are sturdier from the start and become faster and more accurate later on. A swarm of tiny soldiers slows enemies that enter their zone, you can mend a damaged creation by spending a healing surge, and your clockwork companion marks foes while granting nearby characters temporary hit points.

paths.title: Master Preserver
paths.description: Draw on the vital energy around you without harming it, and let that restraint make you tougher, healthier and a better steward of your allies. The land sharpens your Endurance, Nature and Perception, and an action point lets you reroll an attack or damage roll and keep the better result. At higher levels every healing surge you spend heals a nearby ally and sharpens your aim. Your spells turn an enemy's vitality into healing, shield a friend from a blow, and bathe the battlefield in a zone of weakening, restorative light.

limitations: Authoring and printed rules only; runtime path effects and progression are unimplemented.
Published prerequisite not enforced: Arcane class.

paths.title: Spell Commander
paths.description: Command your allies like a squad leader, turning every friend into a spell delivery system. A bow or crossbow works as your implement and extends your reach, and an action point lets a nearby ally add a free attack to your own. Later, adjacent allies can swap their basic attacks for arcane at-will powers. Your powers guide spells toward a target, retune an ally's damage type as they swing, and open a living gate that teleports you and your friends across the field.

limitations: Authoring and printed rules only; runtime path effects and progression are unimplemented.

paths.title: Agent of the Unbroken Circle
paths.description: You hunt corruption as part of a sworn circle, turning your oath of enmity into a rallying point for everyone beside you. Spending an action point lets your allies hit your target harder while they flank it, and a critical hit gives nearby allies a chance to shake off what afflicts them. Training in Insight and Society keeps you alert to rot in the shadows, while a radiant halo bolsters saving throws for any group that crowds your quarry.

paths.title: Favored Soul
paths.description: Heaven's blessing awakens within you, rewarding the avenger who keeps fighting at full strength. Your action points can pull an ally back from the brink with a healing surge, and unbroken health hardens every one of your defenses. At 16th level feathered wings let you fly in light or no armor, and you can streak across the battlefield with a radiant charge or a sweeping series of aerial strikes that daze and stun the foes you pass.

paths.title: Fortune Blessed
paths.description: Avandra's favor turns chance itself into a resource you can bank and spend. Natural 1s and 20s earn luck tokens, and a token spent later nudges a roll upward or lets you try it again, while an action point can win you another token through a saving throw. Misfortune's Curse turns an enemy's missed blow into a gift for you, a lucky break can blunt a hit that would have hurt badly, and your daily attack leaves a foe dazed and slowed while you force its saves to be rerolled.

paths.title: Hammer of Judgment
paths.description: You judge the battlefield like a smith working metal, shoving and hammering enemies exactly where your god wants them. Your action point attacks drive hit foes backward, daily attacks leave targets easier to strike, and bloodied creatures can be flung even farther by any forced movement you inflict. Wielding a hammer stretches every push further, and you can answer a rough turn by shrugging off damage or slamming the ground with a thunderous burst that topples nearby enemies.

paths.title: Oathsworn
paths.description: Your word carries the weight of creation, and your Oath of Enmity becomes a binding sentence on the enemy it names. That foe finds you harder to hit, your action point attacks roll twice against every target, and slaying your sworn enemy lets you recover with a healing surge. Weakening strikes, a prayer that lends your allies the same twin rolls, and a daily bond that leaves the target vulnerable round out a path of grim, focused retribution.

paths.title: Serene Initiate
paths.description: Calm discipline guides your blade, and every swing lands as a measured act rather than a flash of anger. Spending an action point on an at-will attack adds a burst of extra damage, while misses against your sworn enemy still draw blood. A cutting encounter strike punishes targets that dare to act, and a stance and a daily attack reward you with sharper results whenever your Oath of Enmity gives you two attack rolls.

paths.title: Soulforged
paths.description: You are tempered in the white flames of Moradin's forge and carry its fire into every strike. Spending an action point restores a spent Channel Divinity use or an encounter attack, and your weapon can blaze with fire and radiant light at will. A burning blast scorches nearby foes, an interrupt hardens you against danger, and your daily attack makes the ground around you hard to cross while your hits keep burning with extra Wisdom damage.

paths.title: Zealous Assassin
paths.description: You slip through the edges of combat and strike with the swift efficiency of a divine knife in the dark. An action point grants concealment and a short teleport, and combat advantage or a bloodied foe makes your blows land harder. Charging from hiding can let you strike with the upper hand, while a prayer can erase you from an enemy's sight and your signature attack sears a target with radiant fire that leaves it exposed.

paths.title: Bear Warrior
paths.description: Take on a bear's shape when you rage, gaining tougher protection and the freedom to catch your breath with second wind without slowing your assault. Action points offer further healing, while mauling blows knock enemies down and threaten another strike when they stand beside you. Your growing strength sends foes flying on a raging critical hit, and your fiercest rage carries you between opponents before settling into steady regeneration and resistance to being moved.

With experience, you resist the cold and can turn ordinary damage into frost, and your greatest rage lets each at-will hit hold its victim in place for another assault.

features.title: Avandra's Luck
features.description:
Whenever you roll a natural 1 or 20 on an attack roll or saving throw during an encounter, you gain 1 luck token. Luck tokens remain until you spend them or until you take an extended rest, at which point you remove all unexpended luck tokens.

Whenever you make an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check on your turn, you can expend one luck token after seeing the result. Roll a d6. On a result of 1–3, you gain a +1 bonus to the triggering roll. On a 4 or 5, you gain a +2 bonus to the triggering roll. On a 6, you can reroll the triggering roll and use the result you like. You have no limit to the number of luck tokens you can spend during an encounter, but you can spend only one token per turn.

features.title: Bolstering Blood

You learn to turn your own pain into additional pain for your enemies. When you use a wizard encounter attack power, a wizard daily attack power, or a blood mage attack power that deals damage, you can, once per turn as a free action just prior to using the power, deal either a minor wound or a severe wound to yourself.

A minor wound deals 1d10 damage to you.

A severe wound deals 2d10 damage to you.

You then gain a bonus to the power's damage rolls. The bonus equals the damage you dealt to yourself.

Once per day, you can reach into the spellstorm and extract an arcane power that you have already used so that you can use it again. Make a Wisdom check. The result indicates the kind of arcane power that you can extract. You can choose to extract an arcane power associated with a lower result than the result you rolled.

11–15: Arcane encounter attack power.

16–20: Arcane daily utility power.

21 or Higher: Arcane daily attack power.

A Thousand FacesSteadfast Sentinel Utility 16
Your face and form shift to take on the appearance of another creature flawlessly.
At-Will   ✦     Polymorph, Primal
Minor Action      Personal
Effect: You alter your physical form to take on the appearance of any humanoid of your size category. You retain your game statistics in your new form. You can also transform the physical appearance of your clothing, armor, and possessions, though they must remain present and maintain the same general shape. For example, you could make your bejeweled scimitar look like a rusted relic, but you could not make it appear to be a backpack or cause it to disappear. Your new form lasts until you use this power again or until you end it as a free action.
Any creature that attempts to see through your ruse makes an Insight check opposed by your Bluff check. You gain a +5 bonus to your check.
Special: You can use this power only once per round.
Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

Ride the Giant DownGiantslayer Utility 12
You scramble onto the creature's back, distracting it and gaining a better position to bring it down.
Daily   ✦     Martial
Move Action      Melee 1
Target: One Large or larger creature
Effect: You move into the target's space, provoking opportunity attacks as normal. Until you leave the target's space, the target grants combat advantage to you and your allies and takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls, and you grant combat advantage to other enemies. Any attack that damages you also deals half the attack's damage to the target. When the target moves, you move with it, staying in the same portion of the target's space.
If the target hits you with a melee attack, it can slide you 1 square to a square adjacent to its space unless you succeed on a saving throw.
Special: If you're trained in Athletics, you don't grant combat advantage to other enemies because of being in the target's space, and you can make a saving throw to negate any pull, push, or slide that would move you out of the target's space.
Update (11/23/2009)
In the last sentence of the Effect line, add “1 square” between “you” and “to.”
Published in Martial Power, page(s) 62.

Form of the All-SpiritScion of the All-Spirit Attack 20
Your body becomes a miasma of primal spirits encompassing animal, plant, weather, and elemental aspects in equal parts. Your new form reaches out to your allies and strikes at your foes.
Daily   ✦     Polymorph, Primal
Minor Action      Personal
Effect: You assume the guardian form of the All-Spirit until the end of the encounter. While you are in this form, you gain a +1 power bonus to all defenses. In addition, you and each ally adjacent to you gain resist 5 to all damage.
Once during this encounter, you can use the All-Spirit Attack power while you are in this form.
All-Spirit Attack
Encounter ✦     Polymorph, Primal, Weapon
Standard Action      Melee weapon
Requirement: The power Form of the All-Spirit must be active in order to use this power.
Effect: Before the attack, you teleport your speed.
Target: One creature
Attack: Strength vs. Will
Hit: 2[W] + Strength modifier damage, and the target is dominated until the end of your next turn.
Miss: Half damage, and the target is dazed until the end of your next turn.
Published in Dragon Magazine 386, page(s) 79.

source.rulesText:
Wall of WinterRimetongue Caller Attack 11
Issuing words of Primordial from frost-covered lips, you conjure an unstable wall of elemental ice and wind.
Encounter   ✦     Arcane, Cold, Conjuration, Implement
Standard Action      Area wall 5 within 20 squares
Effect: You conjure a wall of contiguous squares filled with frost and raging wind that lasts until the end of your next turn. The wall can be up to 4 squares high.
Each creature that starts its turn adjacent to the wall takes 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier cold damage. If a creature moves into the wall's space or starts its turn there, it takes 2d8 + your Intelligence modifier cold damage, and it is slowed (save ends). A creature can take this damage only once per turn. Entering a square occupied by the wall costs 1 extra square of movement. The squares occupied by the wall are heavily obscured, and the wall blocks line of sight.
Update (2/17/2012)
Changed in December 2011 updates.
Published in Arcane Power, page(s) 119.

You trap your enemies in a cage made of lightning and filled with roaring thunder.

Standard Action      Area burst 2 within 20 squares
Target: Each creature in the burst
